summary: GSK plc filed Form 6-K reporting a routine grant of a deferred share award to a newly appointed PDMR under its existing equity compensation plan. The award of 35,508 notional ordinary shares at £19.01 vests in two tranches in 2028 and 2029, with dividend accrual and cash settlement on vesting. No corporate action, acquisition, divestiture, or special event is involved. This is a standard compensation disclosure with no special-situation characteristics.
